description: This file defines the ErrorLogStrategy class responsible for logging error messages within the ngMayo.Logging.LogStrategy namespace. It implements error logging using an injected ILogger and extends an abstract logging strategy. It contains methods to execute error logs based on LogModel objects or message/data strings.

classes.name: ErrorLogStrategy
classes.description: A class that logs error messages by utilizing an injected ILogger. It extends AbstractLogStrategy and implements methods to log errors based on LogModel data or message/data strings.

methods.name: ErrorLogStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an ILogger instance and passes it to the base class.

methods.name: Execute (LogModel log)
methods.description: Logs an error based on a LogModel object, using the message and data contained within.

methods.name: Execute (string message, string data)
methods.description: Logs an error message along with associated data provided as strings.
